items.assumption: Model the complete paired double-house because the original EG/DG/section/elevation drawings dimension the full 19.80 m building.
items.source: EG.pdf; DG.pdf; Grundrisse, Schnitt.pdf; Umbauter Raum.pdf
items.impact: The seed shows both mirrored halves even though the expose is for one semi-detached half.

items.assumption: Weidenstrasse 6 is the current subject half of the paired context.
items.impact: Room and area metadata uses the one-half DIN 283 calculation while geometry keeps the full pair.

items.assumption: Site is centered and simplified as a starter toposolid/property context, not a surveyed parcel model.
items.impact: The building is on terrain and within property starter lines; exact cadastral geometry remains later work.

items.assumption: Historic stair, dormer, roof, and facade details are represented with supported BIM proxies.
items.impact: The model is suitable for project initiation, not detailed construction documentation.
